bullets.text: Tata Steel group CFO Koushik Chatterjee, 2-on-1 today 11:00 at the JPM India Conference, St. Regis Mumbai.

bullets.text: AI copper-clad laminate prices rising on tight capacity; GS puts the CCL TAM at US$47.5bn by 2028.
bullets.source: GS Daily - Trump-Xi meeting to expect // SMIC strong AI demand // Shenyi Tech AI CCL growth and capacity // Samsung Electronics // Japan banks

detail.summary: GS maintains Shengyi Tech at Buy (TP Rmb249) on tight AI CCL supply and rising specification-driven pricing. It forecasts 3Q26 revenue +59% YoY to Rmb13bn, gross margin above 30%, and a 33% net income CAGR through 2030E.
points: TP Rmb249, Buy maintained on CL
AI CCL TAM: US$47.5bn by 2028
3Q26 revenue +59% YoY, +16% QoQ to Rmb13bn
Gross margin sustaining above 30%
33% net income CAGR 2026-30E; new Thailand/China capacity

bullets.text: CLSA reiterates Underperform Wipro, Hold TCS/Infosys/HCLT/TechM after ANSR channel check; GCCs a tailwind, headwind for mature SIs.
bullets.source: CLSA - India IT: ANSR call KTAs: GCC & SI to coexist

detail.summary: CLSA hosted ANSR's CMO on the India GCC/SI landscape: both coexist, with GCCs covering talent gaps and core work while SIs keep non-critical work. GCC growth stays strong as EU, UK and ANZ geographies open up, a net tailwind for SIs but a headwind for mature large-caps.
points: 1,800-2,700 people is the GCC 'sweet spot' headcount
GCC city split: Bangalore 30%, Hyderabad ~20%, Delhi NCR 14%
FDE costs in India ~4x lower than US-based FDEs
Underperform Wipro; Hold TCS, Infosys, HCLT, TechM reiterated

bullets.text: BofA turns constructive on Nifty (PT 26.2k by Dec'26, +12%) as India AI-exposure concern eases from 32% to 10% of its survey.
bullets.source: BofA - APAC Signal-to-Noise: From localization to monetization

detail.summary: BofA's Asia Fund Manager Survey shows worries about India's limited AI exposure easing sharply, and India strategist Amish Shah turns constructive on Nifty after two years of caution, citing five of eight previously flagged risks as priced in or played out.
points: India AI-exposure concern: 32% to 10% of survey respondents
Nifty PT 26.2k by Dec'26, ~12% upside implied
5 of 8 previously flagged risks priced in/played out
Asia FMS: 80% await AI monetization proof before adding exposure

bullets.text: UBS: Brent above $100/bbl cuts FY27 India GDP ~20bps, lifts CPI to 5.5%, and puts the RBI into 50bps of hikes.
bullets.source: UBS - Hi Rajvaibhav UBS India: what's trending in India's macro

detail.summary: UBS's India economist models Brent averaging $100/bbl versus an $85 baseline as a stagflationary shock for FY27 - slower growth, higher inflation, a wider current account - that pushes the RBI into a hiking cycle starting the October policy meeting.
points: $100/bbl Brent scenario vs $85 baseline for FY27
FY27 GDP growth slows ~20bps vs 6.9% base
FY27 CPI could reach 5.5% on energy & food
50bps cumulative RBI hikes seen from October
CAD could widen toward 2% of GDP

bullets.text: JPM: Brent at $106 carries a ~$16 risk premium to its ~$90 fair value; desk still sees one more Fed hike, in December.
bullets.source: JPM - Overnight Brief! 9/21 - Chase spending Data accelerated in Sep by drawing on investment wealth

detail.summary: JPM's oil model puts September fair value near $90 while Brent trades near $106, implying a large geopolitical risk premium that has not resolved; the desk raised its Treasury yield targets and still expects one further Fed hike in December after this week's move.
points: Brent $106 vs ~$90 JPM 'fair value' estimate
~$16/bbl risk premium implied by the gap
10Y UST +7bps to 4.99%, 2Y +8bps to 4.74%
One more Fed hike seen, in December
YE26 2Y target raised 40bp to 4.70%; 10Y to 5.05%

bullets.text: BofA initiates Ather Energy at Buy, PO Rs1,900 (18% upside from Rs1,614), EBITDA breakeven targeted FY28.
bullets.source: BofA - ATHERENE IN: Ather Energy: Road to a million: Scale meets margins. Initiate at Buy

detail.summary: BofA's initiation argues Ather is past product validation and entering a scale phase, with the EL platform cutting BOM 8-10% and driving margin inflexion alongside capacity tripling to 1.4m units by FY29.
points: PO Rs1,900 vs price Rs1,614 (18% upside)
16% market share, Top 3 E-2W player
Capacity to triple to 1.4m units by FY29
EL platform cuts BOM 8-10%
EBITDA margin 12.4% by FY31

bullets.text: Avendus Spark initiates Gabriel India at Buy, TP Rs1,560 (37x Sep-28E EPS); kit value seen rising 4x from FY26.
bullets.source: Avendus Spark - AVENDUS SPARK AUTOMOTIVE SECTOR - Gabriel India: Initiating Coverage (Rating: BUY, TP: 1,560)

detail.summary: Avendus Spark frames Gabriel as Anand Group's consolidation vehicle, with kit value per vehicle potentially rising 4x from FY26 as JVs (Dana, HL Mando/Klemove) and other Anand entities merge in, targeting Rs500bn group revenue by 2030.
points: TP Rs1,560 at 37x Sep-28E EPS
Kit value up to 4x FY26 levels
Group revenue target Rs500bn by 2030
FY26-30E revenue/EBITDA/EPS CAGR 19%/22%/32%
Standalone EBITDA margin target double-digit vs ~8.5% now

bullets.text: Paramount Communications guides Rs50bn revenue by FY31 (21% CAGR), Narmadapuram online Q1FY28, margin to ~8% by Q4FY27.
bullets.source: Aditya Birla Capital - Paramount Communications (NOT RATED) | Company Update: Turnaround sets the stage for capacity-led growth (+1 more in Outlook)

detail.summary: Aditya Birla Capital's note (Not Rated) says PRMC has already scaled revenue over 3x since FY22 and targets Rs50bn by FY31 on a new Rs3bn Narmadapuram facility, with margins recovering as US tariff normalisation restores parity.
points: Revenue scaled 3x to ~Rs19bn FY26 from ~Rs6bn FY22
Rs50bn revenue target by FY31, 21% CAGR
~Rs3bn Narmadapuram facility, commissioning Q1FY28
EBITDA margin to recover to ~8% by Q4FY27
Medium-term aspiration: double-digit margins
